title: The DNA binding of plant-specific GROWTH-REGULATING FACTOR transcription factors is stabilized by GRF-INTERACTING FACTOR coactivators.
one_liner_zh: 该文结合生化实验与AlphaFold结构预测，研究植物GRF转录因子与GIF共激活因子互作如何稳定其DNA结合，属于TF-DNA互作机制的结构建模研究，但方法以实验为主、AI仅辅助预测，深度有限。
abstract: The plant-specific GROWTH-REGULATING FACTOR (GRF) transcription factor family proteins play crucial role in regulating diverse aspects of plant life. The transcriptional activity of GRFs is known to be enhanced through direct interaction with the GRF-INTERACTING FACTOR (GIF) coactivators. However, it remains unclear how the binding to GIF affects the biochemical ability of GRFs. Herein, we present evidence that GIFs also stabilize the DNA binding of GRFs. A combination of biochemical experiments and AlphaFold-predicted structural models suggests that the GIF-binding domain in GRFs may partially restrict their own DNA binding through direct interaction with the DNA-binding domain in the absence of GIFs. These findings deepen our understanding of the GRF:GIF module in plant regulation and provide a basis for strategies to manipulate this module for agricultural and biotechnological applications.
abstract_zh: 植物特有的生长调节因子（GRF）转录因子家族蛋白在调控植物生命活动的多个方面中发挥关键作用。已知GRFs的转录活性通过与GRF互作因子（GIF）共激活因子的直接相互作用而增强。然而，GIF结合如何影响GRFs的生化能力仍不清楚。在此，我们提供证据表明GIFs还能稳定GRFs的DNA结合。结合生化实验和AlphaFold预测的结构模型提示，在缺乏GIFs的情况下，GRFs中的GIF结合域可能通过直接与DNA结合域相互作用，部分限制其自身的DNA结合。这些发现加深了我们对植物调控中GRF:GIF模块的理解，并为利用该模块进行农业和生物技术应用的策略提供了基础。
